checklist.name: Release checklist
steps: Run the full test suite on the release branch.
Tag the release and write the changelog entry.
Deploy to staging and check the smoke tests.
Deploy to production during a working hour.
Post the release notes in the releases channel.

report.text: Ran the full suite on release/1.8.0 and it came back green. Tagged v1.8.0 and wrote the changelog entry for it. Deployed to staging and the smoke tests were green. Deployed to production at 10:20 on Tuesday.
